summary: Nex Neo Tech Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Loan Agreement and Convertible Promissory Note Agreement with Zetoria LLC. The investor agreed to lend up to $20,000 for working capital, bearing 3% interest, maturing one year after each advance. Principal and accrued interest are convertible into common stock at $0.08 per share, yielding up to 250,000 shares if fully drawn and converted. No amounts advanced as of the filing date. The transaction is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. Watch for future draws and conversions that could affect dilution.
